repair_design.summary: Replace the fixed 8 ms sleep before the eviction assertion with an interruptible wait on the same file's real isInMemory state.
repair_design.state_scope: The awaited TachyonFile is local to one invocation; the only static additions are immutable timeout constants and a stateless helper.
repair_design.wait_bound_rationale: The bound is 6.25 times the confirmed 800 ms delay and preserves the test's 3 ms heartbeat configuration.

ordinary.process_model: 100 independently launched Java 8 processes; one JUnit target method per process

missing_completion.candidate_diagnostic: file was not evicted within the bounded wait

multi_writer.reason: The repair adds no counter, signal publication, or shared mutable state for writers to update.

state_leakage.evidence: No mutable static repair state exists; ten target invocations and a peer passed in one JVM, and the full 24-method target class passed.

causal_conclusion: The same confirmed 800 ms trigger failed all five unpatched controls and passed all five repaired runs.
claim_boundary: One manually designed repair for FS005; this does not estimate effectiveness on other cases.

source_ledger.transformation: Removed timestamps, commands, raw-log paths, and witness-file paths; retained case identity, verdicts, bounds, counted outcomes, and causal witnesses.
